summary: Damen Shipyards Group is shipbuilding company, founded in 1927. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 25% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: Family-owned shipbuilding group with about 12,000 professionals worldwide; its naval division builds advanced naval vessels.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Steady flow of new orders and deliveries, from tugs for Seaspan and Svitzer to offshore wind vessels for Taiwan.

worth_knowing.text: NRC reported the Netherlands has boxed itself in by depending on Damen as its naval shipyard.
A Dutch state secretary visited the Damen Naval yard in Vlissingen.
